newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U, Amersham to merge life science units.
newsitem.headline: P&U, Amersham to merge life science units.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Tuesday that it is merging its life science unit Pharmacia Biotech with that of Amersham International
P&U said in a statement that the merger of Pharmacia Biotech and Amersham Life Science would create a new company called Amersham Pharmacia Biotech of which P&U would hold 45 percent.
The companies plan to list the new group on one or more bourses after some time of integration, the companies said in a joint statement.

"As of January 1, 2000, Pharmacia & Upjohn has the right to sell out of the company and Amersham International has the right to acquire Pharmacia & Upjohn's shares up until January 2004," the companies said.
Pharmacia & Upjohn also has a put option as of January 2000.
The new group with 3,600 employees will be the world's largest research based biotechnology supplier by turnover with annual sales totalling $700 million, the statement said.
The new company will develop and supply instruments and expert knowledge as well as chemicals for biotechnology research.
"With one of the highest R&D (research & development) investments in its area, close to 40 million sterling, conditions are created to develop innovative technologies," the companies said.
"The combined competence within R&D will contribute further to develop solutions directed toward markets with a fast growth rate."
Amersham Pharmacia Biotech will have its in legal base Britain while the operational headquarters will be in Uppsala, Sweden.

Income and cost synergies are expected to result in cost savings of about 22 million sterling before tax in the fiscal year ending in March 1999 and at least 30 million sterling annually thereafter, the companies said.

"The merger is a result of Pharmacia & Upjohn's strategy to supply Associated Businesses with necessary resources to become successful at the same time as the group can focus on its core operations," said Donald Parfet, senior vice president of P&U and board member of Pharmacia Biotech.
